pages.title: Your turn
pages.body: Move one of your glyphlings any distance along a leyline — it can’t pass through anything. Then plant a seed from where it landed, along any leyline, onto an empty hex.

pages.title: Words make Magic
pages.body: Every word the new seed makes, on every leyline, grows Magic: one per letter, plus one for each of your own seeds in it. Made Magic? Draw a seed. Made none? You may refresh your seeds.

pages.title: A tangled garden
pages.body: A glyphling with nowhere to move is tangled. When two are tangled the game ends: each rival piece next to a tangled glyphling earns its owner +3. Magic stays secret until the end — most Magic becomes Grand Glyphtender!

tutorial._help: The first game teaches itself (design/tutorial.md). Callouts: one idea, 12 words or fewer, verb first.
tutorial.locked: Finish your first game to unlock this.

pages.title: Move, then plant
pages.body: Move one of your glyphlings, then plant a seed from where it lands.

pages.title: Words make Magic
pages.body: Spell words to make Magic. Most Magic wins.

pages.title: A tangled garden
pages.body: A glyphling that can't move is tangled. The game ends when any 2 glyphlings are tangled.

leave.title: Leave the tutorial game?
leave.message: Everything unlocks. You can replay it from Settings.

replay.title: Replay the tutorial game?
replay.message: This game ends, and the tutorial game starts.

rails._help: The tutorial game's first 2 turns (design/tutorial.md §2), one callout at a time. {rival} = Sprout's colour (Blue). Every line must stay literally true.
rails.draft1: Drag your glyphling to the glowing hex.
rails.draft2: Drag your second glyphling to the glowing hex.
rails.block: Pieces block the way — glyphlings can't pass through them.
rails.overOwn: Seeds fly over your own pieces — not other players'.
rails.seed1: Plant the {letter}: drag it to the glowing hex.
rails.blocks: Your seed blocks {rival}'s glyphling. Hemming glyphlings in can win games.
rails.noWord: No word, no Magic. You can swap seeds you don't want.
rails.refresh: Tap Refresh — new seeds grow in.
rails.preview: The button shows the Magic you'll make. Tap Plant!
rails.counts: Your seeds count +2 in a word. Others' count +1.
rails.secret: Magic is secret until the end — {rival} can't see yours.
rails.handOver: You're on your own now — have fun!

explore._help: Explore mode — the ? button (design/tutorial.md §6): tap anything and read what it is. {player} = whose it is, {moves} = how many moves it has, {own} / {other} = what a seed counts in its owner's words / anyone else's. Every line must stay literally true.
